line.en: the saturday market runs 6 to 4 at eastern market. walk the sheds and the stalls before the lunch crowd.
line.de: der samstagsmarkt läuft von 6 bis 16 uhr am eastern market. durch die hallen und stände schlendern, bevor das mittagsgedränge kommt.
line.tr: cumartesi pazarı 6 ile 16 arasında eastern market'te. mittagdan önce hallerde ve tezgâhlarda dolaşın.

sparks.why: Eastern Market Saturday market, 6 a.m. to 4 p.m., 2934 Russell St (MarketSpread event listing; check easternmarket.org).
